items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Related sections with single or multiple expansion, keyboard navigation and a smooth change in layout height.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A chronological history of people and system updates, with optional date groups, details and actions. The card grows with its content or keeps an explicit height with native scrolling.

items.name: activity-rings-card
items.title: Activity Rings
items.description: Three concentric goals show movement, exercise and running progress in a compact card.

items.name: agent-creator
items.title: Agent Creator
items.description: A configurable identity panel for an agent: shape, color, name, voice, language, and notification preferences.

items.name: agent-limits-card
items.title: Agent Limits
items.description: A usage panel composed from the shared Meter and Collapsible, with segmented capacity, member details, compact density, semantic tones and labels for general product quotas.

items.name: agent-progress
items.title: Agent Progress
items.description: A collapsible multi-step progress panel that keeps active work, completion, and timing readable in a small footprint.

items.name: agent-thinking
items.title: Agent Thinking
items.description: A lightweight status indicator for work in progress, with five motion variants and an elapsed timer.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message with semantic colors, optional actions and dismissal. Use a live announcement only when a new message needs attention.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: A compact message card for onboarding and product updates. It supports an icon, a focused action, and an animated dismiss control.

items.name: area-chart-card
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: A layered time series card with three sources and an accessible SVG summary.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A responsive media container that reserves exact bounds before content loads, with cover or contain fitting and four corner options.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth Card
items.description: A sign-in, sign-up, or verification panel that composes form fields with provider buttons and hands data to your authentication layer.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person’s photo or initials in four measured sizes. Initials remain visible if the image fails to load.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small count labels for navigation and unread totals. The primary color sits comfortably on selected surfaces.

items.name: bar-list-card
items.title: Bar List
items.description: A ranked horizontal breakdown with clear labels and percentages.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A compact path through the interface. Ancestors are interactive, while the current page is announced clearly to assistive technology.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary, secondary, ghost, and danger actions in three sizes, with clear hover, pressed, focus, and disabled states.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Related controls share one border and a quiet shadow. Use the selected state for toolbars and compact filters.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid with colored events, month navigation, overflow counts, event details, and a new-event action.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A shared content surface with measured padding, headers and footers. Compose it from the same controls as the rest of your product.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A gallery driven by native scrolling and scroll snap. Touch, trackpad, keyboard, arrows, and position controls all stay in sync.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A precise 16px choice control built on React Aria. Checked, mixed, disabled, and labelled states share one visual language.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Compact color labels for statuses, values, and tags. Three emphasis levels cover nine semantic color pairs.

items.name: close-button
items.title: Close Button
items.description: The circular dismiss action for compact surfaces and dialogs. Four sizes keep the icon stroke crisp at every scale.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A shared code surface with exact-source copying, animated format changes, optional line numbers, highlighted lines, wrapping and native scrolling. Code remains selectable and the surrounding layout follows content height.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: An animated content region that preserves child state while removing hidden content from keyboard navigation and the accessibility tree.

items.name: color-swatch
items.title: Color Swatch
items.description: Color previews and accessible named palette choices, with transparency, three sizes, circular or square shapes, flat or gloss surfaces and native keyboard selection.

items.name: combo-chart-card
items.title: Combo Chart
items.description: Bars and point markers show two related measures on one compact plot.

items.name: combobox
items.title: ComboBox
items.description: Search a list of choices with keyboard navigation, rich option details, disabled items and a useful empty state.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: Searchable, grouped actions with keyboard navigation, optional descriptions, shortcuts and a fixed scrolling area. The search field keeps focus while you move between results.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: The shared Command Menu inside a focus-trapped Dialog. An optional hideHeader surface keeps its accessible title while showing search directly. Search and result changes preserve the panel bounds; choosing an action can close the palette or keep it available.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: A responsive message composer with model selection, attachments, voice action, project context, and working state.

items.name: composer-attachments
items.title: Composer Attachments
items.description: A strip of compact attachment tiles with thumbnails, progress rings, add, and remove actions.

items.name: composer-loader
items.title: Composer Loader
items.description: A measured animated edge that signals active work around a composer or another contained surface.

items.name: composer-panel
items.title: Composer Panel
items.description: A two-row composer with permission modes, provider and model search, reasoning effort, attachments and a configurable status tab.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Actions at the pointer, with touch long press and keyboard access. Shared menus support submenus, shortcuts, independent selections and animated density.

items.name: contributions-card
items.title: Contributions
items.description: A dense contribution calendar with an activity summary and keyboard focus for each day.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: A responsive message viewport that follows new content while you are at the end and preserves your place when you scroll up to read earlier messages.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A searchable, sortable and paginated data grid driven by TanStack Table, with filters and row selection.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Choose a single day or a date range in a calendar that supports keyboard navigation, quick ranges, editable dates, and an explicit Apply action.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A focused modal surface with a named header, dynamic content, optional actions, keyboard dismissal and focus restoration.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: A scoped locale and DOM direction for readable layout, logical keyboard navigation and portaled controls. Nested scopes preserve the surrounding application.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A composable separator for dense interfaces. A hairline, framed double line, or soft filled strip can hold text and compact controls.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A side or bottom detail surface that shares Dialog behavior, fits its viewport and keeps header and actions reachable.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: A compact action surface with grouped items, keyboard navigation, and a soft entrance. Selection returns focus to the trigger.

items.name: earnings-chart-card
items.title: Earnings Chart
items.description: A monthly earnings view with goal tracks and a period selector.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A clear explanation and useful next action for an empty collection, filtered result, first visit or unavailable content.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Responsive form layout around shared controls, with their existing labels, descriptions and validation intact. Group columns follow their container; fieldsets provide legends and inherited disabled state.

items.name: file-explorer
items.title: File Explorer
items.description: A file panel composed from Tree, SearchField, ScrollArea and Card. Search retains matching ancestors, manual expansion survives search, and constrained panels use native scrolling with directional controls.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A keyboard-accessible dropzone with file type and size validation, visible progress, and clear completion feedback.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Search, Select, removable Chips and a result summary composed into a responsive collection toolbar. The parent owns the filtered data.

items.name: funnel-chart-card
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: A conversion path that keeps stage totals and relative completion visible.

items.name: heatmap-chart-card
items.title: Heatmap Chart
items.description: A grid of activity levels that remains inspectable by keyboard and pointer.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A non-modal preview for people, sources and related objects. Hover or focus to inspect details, then move into its actions without losing your place.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A compact action control for rows and toolbars. Every icon-only action has an accessible name and a clear focus state.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A labelled field built on React Aria, with leading and trailing adornments, hint text, required state, and error feedback.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Inline icons, text, actions and block additions composed from the shared Input and Textarea, with their labels, focus and validation intact.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One accessible input rendered as a sequence of code slots. Paste, autofill, and keyboard editing work as a single value.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Content rows composed from Card, with media, text and ordinary actions. Three surfaces, three sizes, native list groups and complete row links share the same typography and responsive layout.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Compact keyboard hints and shortcut groups in soft or outlined surfaces. The visual hint does not register a shortcut by itself.

items.name: line-chart-card
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A single time series with a soft area fill and measured axis labels.

items.name: link-button
items.title: Link Button
items.description: An inline navigation action with measured icon spacing and a gentle directional hover cue.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Application commands in a persistent bar, with one Tab stop, logical arrow navigation, nested actions and independent selection groups.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A user, assistant or system message with consistent type, optional identity, time, sources and actions. Streaming responses keep their actions out of the way.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message Actions
items.description: A compact response action row with real clipboard confirmation, optional feedback, regeneration and read-aloud callbacks.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A quantity within a known range, for storage, capacity, quotas and usage. Optional segments show its parts while preserving the total and the accessible value.

items.name: most-active-days-card
items.title: Most Active Days
items.description: A scrolling month calendar with activity rings, smooth month navigation and selectable days.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site links with expandable panels, ordinary Tab navigation and measured height transitions. Choose a floating dropdown or inline expansion, with scoped logical direction.

items.name: notification
items.title: Notification
items.description: Shared notification cards with tone, avatar, actions and timed dismissal. A scoped provider presents a list or animated stack, with queue limits, paused timers, keyboard navigation and updates for pending operations.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: An inbox with category tabs, unread state, inline actions, and a mark-all-read control.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A locale-aware numeric control with keyboard and press-and-hold steppers, range limits, currency formatting and associated validation.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A setup card with required and optional tasks, progress, actions and an animated disclosure. Completion can follow application data or direct checkbox choices, with controlled state and optional dismissal.

items.name: orders-chart-card
items.title: Orders Chart
items.description: Grouped bars compare current and previous order totals over time.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A controlled page navigator that keeps nearby pages visible and collapses long ranges into ellipses.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A positioned content surface with focus management, optional arrow, controlled state and dismissal that returns to its trigger.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate and indeterminate progress in bars or rings, with an accessible label, custom range and animated updates.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A stepped question flow with single and multiple selections, optional custom answers, and a completion callback.

items.name: radar-chart-card
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A radial comparison of several categories, drawn as an accessible SVG polygon.

items.name: radial-chart-card
items.title: Radial Chart
items.description: Nested rings compare a collection of proportions with a supporting legend.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A single-choice control built on React Aria, with keyboard navigation, form semantics, compact sizes, and full-card options.

items.name: revenue-chart-card
items.title: Revenue Chart
items.description: A revenue trend card with a muted comparison line for the previous period.

items.name: sankey-chart-card
items.title: Sankey Chart
items.description: A flow view connecting source and destination categories with weighted paths.

items.name: scatter-chart-card
items.title: Scatter Chart
items.description: A multi-group scatter plot for comparing account growth and revenue.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Native wheel, touch and keyboard scrolling with animated directional controls instead of a visible scrollbar.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: The shared Input with a search icon, a compact clear action and optional pending indicator. Clearing restores focus to the input.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A persistent configuration choice with soft, outlined and underlined surfaces, two sizes, equal-width or vertical layout and directional keyboard navigation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: An accessible choice popover with shared form validation, three control sizes, menu density options and native scrolling with directional controls.

items.name: settings-modal
items.title: Settings Modal
items.description: An application settings dialog with page navigation, preferences, profile editing, and a save callback.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A floating navigation panel with a workspace identity, search, selected route, badges, secondary actions, and an account footer. The same component can collapse to a compact rail.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Content-shaped loading placeholders with shimmer, pulse or static motion, a smooth content crossfade and a shared busy region.

items.name: sleep-score-card
items.title: Sleep Score
items.description: A single score ring with concise contributors below it.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A precise value control with an inset track, keyboard-adjustable thumb, formatted output, and a two-ended range variant.

items.name: social-button
items.title: Social Button
items.description: Sign-in actions for 24 providers or a custom brand, with three appearances, two sizes, and a navigation mode.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Source cards and inline citations use one source record for the summary, preview and destination. The list can collapse without leaving extra space.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A compact loading indicator with four measured sizes and an accessible progress label.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split Pane
items.description: Two panels with a shared, accessible resize handle. Dragging follows the pointer; keyboard resizing, collapse and restore use the library motion tokens. Content stays mounted when the layout changes direction.

items.name: stage-bars-card
items.title: Stage Bars
items.description: A ranked set of pipeline stages with horizontal bars, counts and a legend.

items.name: stat-cards
items.title: Stat Cards
items.description: Data-driven KPI tiles with a strong value, icon, comparison, and positive or negative change.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: An ordered journey with numbered or label-only steps, optional descriptions, explicit completion and error states, and keyboard navigation. Narrow containers stack numbered steps without shrinking the text.

items.name: steps-card
items.title: Steps Chart
items.description: A weekly step card using goal tracks and bright progress bars.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Show incoming text as it arrives, with a small fade on each appended part and an optional cursor. Content stays readable when motion is reduced.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An accessible toggle with pill and rectangular tracks, three sizes, labelled states, and a full-card variant.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: An accessible React Aria table primitive for keyboard navigation and selection. The preview shows the same table styling with TanStack filtering, sorting and pagination.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A keyboard-accessible way to move between related panels, with a restrained underline or compact pill treatment.

items.name: tag-group
items.title: Tag Group
items.description: A keyboard-accessible group of the library’s Chips for labels, selections and removable filters.

items.name: task-list
items.title: Task List
items.description: An agent activity log that reveals steps one at a time, with animated branches, resource chips, and a live working state.

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team Members
items.description: Controlled member lists and searchable tables built from shared rows, avatars, role/status selectors and confirmation dialogs. The application owns saved members and invite/remove operations.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline field with the same label, hint, and error language as Input, plus auto resize and character counting.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A pressed action with controlled or independent state, three appearances, three sizes and animated feedback.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Related pressed controls with single or multiple selection, joined or separated surfaces and logical keyboard navigation.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: A tool operation with named progress, readable arguments, results, approval and recovery actions. Connect its state and callbacks to your application.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A brief contextual hint that opens on hover and focus, places itself on screen, and enters with a soft scale and blur.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A nested collection with independent focus and selection, controlled expansion, optional guides and animated groups. Single and multiple selection share the same row geometry and keyboard behavior.

items.name: web-search
items.title: Web Search
items.description: A streaming research trail with branching steps, recognizable site marks, and expandable source links.

items.name: workspace-tabs
items.title: Workspace Tabs
items.description: Open documents and conversations in shared accessible tabs. Custom leading content, toolbar/footer slots, separate close buttons, unsaved indicators, contained scrolling and three surfaces work with ordinary keyboard navigation.

families.label: Composer
families.description: One composer family: the base input, a model and permission panel, attachments and an animated loading edge.
families.configuration: Configure Composer with model, attachments, isWorking and slots. ComposerPanel composes provider and permission controls; ComposerLoader decorates the input with an animated edge. These compositions use their own exported components.

families.label: Button
families.description: Related action controls in one family: text buttons, icon actions, navigation links and provider sign-in buttons.
families.configuration: Use variant for visual emphasis, size for geometry and props for loading or icons. Use LinkButton for navigation and SocialButton for provider identity; preserve their native semantics. ButtonGroup remains a separate composition.
